sourcePolicy: Preserve generated masters byte-for-byte. References inform component geometry and palette only. No game integration in this asset pass.
normalization: Terrain atlases: group crop, nearest whole-atlas resize, then cells. Explicit isolated cutout atlases: original grid slots, alpha>=128 silhouette crop per object, nearest aspect-preserving fit to native canvas, bottom-center anchor.
portConvention: North/south material profiles run west-to-east; east/west profiles run north-to-south. Port strings are semantic declarations, not proof of seamless pixels.

assemblies.notes: Original 3x3 island registration. Thin bank and foam stay between grass and water; compare against extended island.
Repeated edges and center expose phase, boundary and terrain-width discontinuities; not certified seamless.
Closed loop from actual bends and straight native tiles; inspect channel width and bank alignment at every join.
Cross with four endcaps. Grass comes from the separate coast atlas, so palette mismatch is intentionally visible.
Repeated vertical straights show bank-width, line and phase continuity; two adjacent channels are an inspection fixture.
Repeated horizontal straight channel reveals exact native joins.
Unobstructed source water crop repeated in both axes. Inspect wave phase and border repetition; no seamlessness certification.
Native isolated stone bridge candidates on a contrasting review background. Abutments still resemble complete short spans, not verified attachable ends.
Four isolated gold-rock cluster variants. Shape, baseline and alpha review; this is not a certified edge-joining ridge set.
Original four cardinal scarp roles: south/north/east/west; inspect raised-grass side and natural earth face.
South-facing ledge repeated horizontally: plateau is NORTH. Inspect edge phase, grass/earth balance and rock lip.
North-facing ledge repeated horizontally: plateau is SOUTH. Adjacent runs are candidates, not certified seamless.
East-facing scarp repeated vertically: plateau is WEST.
West-facing scarp repeated vertically: plateau is EAST.

references.scope: Narrow pale shoreline, blue water and opening grass/river palette

uncertainties: The convex-island coast atlas lacks concave land corners and one-cell islands; a separate open-water candidate is cropped from the preserved outer-water corner.
River open ports vary in width and bank position. Metadata describes intended topology, not pixel-perfect compatible edges.
Atlas cells are candidates for assembly; native-size edge and repeat proofs must be inspected before any WFC/seamless claim.
Stone bridge abutment candidates still resemble complete short spans; modular endpoint joins are not certified.
Mountain outputs are transparent isolated cluster variants, not a validated connected ridge autotile set.
Deepwater is a clean outer-water crop from the preserved coast master; its repeat phase and exact joins are unapproved.
Cliff family supplies cardinal scarp edges only; convex/concave corners, stair cuts and exact ground-color compatibility remain unverified.
